entries.1adaff828bdaacd5: Through its construction business, it aims to contribute to creating more comfortable living environments and to building an affluent society. It lists as focus areas “maintenance and renewal of social infrastructure,” “disaster prevention and mitigation,” “energy and environment,” “medical care” and “PPP/PFI,” among others, and aims to become a company in which diverse human resources can thrive, while actively using construction ICT (information-based construction) and AI (artificial intelligence) to save labor and improve labor productivity. Its medium-term management plan, covering the 3 years of the 81st to 83rd fiscal periods, sets as its target image a “company customers think of first” (First Call Company), and while continuing to invest in securing and developing human resources, it works to improve comprehensive competitiveness in technology, quality and price.

entries.caa8d57243d789e1: The public investment market and the private capital investment market are complementary, and the company group operates in both as its business areas, adopting a strategy of focusing on public works orders when the domestic economy is sluggish and on private works orders when private demand is strong. While based in the Chubu region, where its head office is located, it also has bases in Latin America and Southeast Asia, including its consolidated subsidiary in Thailand, and handles overseas construction work. A distinctive feature is that it goes beyond construction work to operate funeral halls and school lunch centers as PFI projects.
